description:
The overnight benchmark-window runner scripts name one absolute checkout path, so a queued measurement runs only from that clone. They resolve the repository root at runtime.

## Background

Scripts: `run-window.sh` and `follow-window.sh` under `dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/bench-window/` set `repo=/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/gf2`. The evidence reproduction how-to under `docs/how-to/` queues its timed run through this runner.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Neither script contains an absolute checkout path; each resolves the repository root at runtime from its own location or from git.
- [hard] REQ-02: A dry or self-test invocation from a second clone path resolves that clone's root, shown in a linked record with the exact command and output.
- [hard] REQ-03: The queue-line format and the window protocol the scripts implement are unchanged, shown by an ignore-whitespace diff review recorded in the commit message.
- [hard] REQ-04: No hard-coded `dev/` path or historical-path allow-list is added; code review checks the change against `@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling`.
title: Resolve the repository root at runtime in the bench-window runner
